020import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.Phase;
021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.settings.ShopSettingEvent;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
023import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
024import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
025
026import java.math.BigDecimal;
027
028/**
029 * ShopBenefitRemoveEvent represents an event triggered when a benefit is removed from a shop.
030 * Handlers can use this to react to benefit removal.
031 *
032 * @author creatorfromhell
033 * @since 6.2.0.9
034 */
035public class ShopBenefitRemoveEvent extends ShopSettingEvent<BigDecimal> {
036
037  private final QUser user;
038
039  public ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(@NotNull final Phase phase, @NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final QUser user, @NotNull final BigDecimal benefit) {
040
041    super(phase, shop, benefit);
042
043    this.user = user;
044  }
045
046  public ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(@NotNull final Phase phase, @NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final QUser user, @NotNull final BigDecimal benefit, @NotNull final BigDecimal updated) {
047
048    super(phase, shop, benefit, updated);
049
050    this.user = user;
051  }
052
053  public static ShopBenefitRemoveEvent PRE(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull QUser user,
054                                           final BigDecimal old) {
055
056    return new ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(Phase.PRE, shop, user, old);
057  }
058
059  public static ShopBenefitRemoveEvent PRE(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull QUser user,
060                                           final BigDecimal old, final BigDecimal updated) {
061
062    return new ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(Phase.PRE, shop, user, updated);
063  }
064
065  public static ShopBenefitRemoveEvent MAIN(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull QUser user,
066                                            final BigDecimal old) {
067
068    return new ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(Phase.MAIN, shop, user, old);
069  }
070
071  public static ShopBenefitRemoveEvent MAIN(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull QUser user,
072                                            final BigDecimal old, final BigDecimal updated) {
073
074    return new ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(Phase.MAIN, shop, user, updated);
075  }
076
077  public static ShopBenefitRemoveEvent POST(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull QUser user,
078                                            final BigDecimal old) {
079
080    return new ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(Phase.POST, shop, user, old);
081  }
082
083  public static ShopBenefitRemoveEvent POST(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull QUser user,
084                                            final BigDecimal old, final BigDecimal updated) {
085
086    return new ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(Phase.POST, shop, user, updated);
087  }
088
089  public static ShopBenefitRemoveEvent RETRIEVE(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull QUser user,
090                                                final BigDecimal old) {
091
092    return new ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(Phase.RETRIEVE, shop, user, old);
093  }
094
095  public static ShopBenefitRemoveEvent RETRIEVE(final @NotNull Shop shop, final @NotNull QUser user,
096                                                final BigDecimal old, final BigDecimal updated) {
097
098    return new ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(Phase.RETRIEVE, shop, user, updated);
099  }
100
101  public QUser getUser() {
102
103    return user;
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Creates a new instance of PhasedEvent with the specified newPhase.
108   *
109   * @param newPhase The new Phase for the cloned PhasedEvent
110   *
111   * @return A new instance of PhasedEvent with the specified newPhase
112   */
113  @Override
114  public ShopBenefitRemoveEvent clone(final Phase newPhase) {
115
116    if(this.updated != null) {
117
118      return new ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(newPhase, this.shop, this.user, this.old, this.updated);
119    }
120
121    return new ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(newPhase, this.shop, this.user, this.old);
122  }
123
124  /**
125   * Creates a clone of the ShopSettingEvent with the provided newPhase, old value, and updated
126   * value.
127   *
128   * @param newPhase The new phase for the cloned ShopSettingEvent
129   * @param old      The old value for the cloned ShopSettingEvent
130   * @param updated  The updated value for the cloned ShopSettingEvent
131   *
132   * @return A new instance of ShopSettingEvent with the specified newPhase, old, and updated values
133   */
134  @Override
135  public ShopBenefitRemoveEvent clone(final Phase newPhase, final BigDecimal old, final BigDecimal updated) {
136
137    return new ShopBenefitRemoveEvent(newPhase, this.shop, this.user, old);
138  }
139}
